name: join
description: Adding a second device to this box, or pointing it here after a move to a server: Tailscale (with the merged one-paste policy snippet) or the relay as the alternative, then whether the new device is actually reachable. Never runs `tailscale up` or edits the tailnet's ACLs itself.

tips.text: Adding a second device or a server? `vyre call join.status` says whether Tailscale or the relay is ready to pair with.
Solo needs none of this: Tailscale and the relay come in only once a second device or a server joins.
